judgments.rationale: The image really is an information pictogram (open hand under speech bubbles with an 'i'), so the stated defect, that the alt describes something the image does not show, is wrong. The patch keeps 'Acesso à Informação'. The real question is that this icon link goes to ouvidoria.ufc.br (Ouvidoria Geral), so its accessible name names a different service than its destination. Because the adjacent visible link reads 'Ouvidoria | Fala.BR' and Fala.BR is the joint ombudsman and access-to-information platform, auditors could reasonably pass it or log it. This finding neither names that issue nor fixes it.
